description: Rick Martinez, candidate for Texas House District 125, is a lifelong San Antonian and community volunteer. He assisted families during the Kerrville flood—evacuating residents, delivering supplies, and supporting recovery efforts. In San Antonio, he serves through homeless outreach and the Food Bank. Committed to honest, community-focused leadership. VOTE RICK FOR TEXAS. RICK MARTINEZ FOR TEXAS HOUSE • DISTRICT 125.
